aboutGame.title: What is Aion 2?
paragraphs: Aion 2 is a next-generation high-fantasy MMORPG developed by NCSOFT, transporting players to the shattered celestial world of Atreia. Built on Unreal Engine 5, the game delivers seamless three-dimensional aerial combat, fluid vertical exploration, and an epic faction struggle between the radiant Elyos and the stoic Asmodians.

Choose from eight iconic character classes—such as Gladiator, Templar, Sorcerer, Assassin, and Cleric—each enhanced with modern combo mechanics. From high-stakes fortress sieges across the Abyss to challenging cooperative PvE instances, Aion 2 offers expansive cross-server battlegrounds and deep build customization.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Aion 2.

items.question: What is Aion 2 and what type of game is it?
items.answer: Aion 2 is a next-generation high-fantasy MMORPG developed by NCSOFT, featuring aerial flight combat, massive faction warfare between Elyos and Asmodians, and rich PvE dungeons set across Atreia.

items.question: Which factions can players choose in Aion 2?
items.answer: In Aion 2, players choose between two rival factions: the radiant Elyos living in Elysea and the resilient Asmodians dwelling in Asmodae, battling for control over the central Abyss.

items.question: What playable classes are available in Aion 2?
items.answer: Aion 2 features eight iconic class archetypes: Gladiator, Templar, Assassin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Spiritmaster, Cleric, and Chanter, each offering distinct skill trees and party synergies.

items.question: Does Aion 2 support open-world PvP and aerial combat?
items.answer: Yes, Aion 2 features seamless three-dimensional flight combat in the Abyss as well as spontaneous open-world PvP skirmishes triggered through dimensional spacetime rifts.

items.question: What platforms can you play Aion 2 on?
items.answer: Aion 2 is developed for PC and mobile platforms with cross-platform progression supported through NCSOFT's PURPLE service.

items.question: How do redemption codes work in Aion 2?
items.answer: Aion 2 redemption codes can be entered in the account management portal or the in-game shop to claim free bonus items including Kinah, Quna, potions, and cosmetic accessories.
